title: FHL2 Inhibits SARS-CoV-2 Replication by Enhancing IFN-beta Expression through Regulating IRF-3.
authors: Xu, Zhiqiang; Tian, Mingyao; Tan, Qihan; Hao, Pengfei; Gao, Zihan; Li, Chang; Jin, Ningyi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究FHL2通过调控IRF-3增强IFN-beta表达抑制SARS-CoV-2复制，属于抗病毒免疫机制研究，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: SARS-CoV-2 triggered the global COVID-19 pandemic, posing a severe threat to public health worldwide. The innate immune response in cells infected by SARS-CoV-2 is primarily orchestrated by type I interferon (IFN), with IFN-beta exhibiting a notable inhibitory impact on SARS-CoV-2 replication. FHL2, acting as a docking site, facilitates the assembly of multiprotein complexes and regulates the transcription of diverse genes. However, the association between SARS-CoV-2 and FHL2 remains unclear. In this study, we report for the first time that SARS-CoV-2 infection in Caco2 cells results in the upregulation of FHL2 expression, while the virus's N proteins can enhance FHL2 expression. Notably, the knockdown of FHL2 significantly amplifies SARS-CoV-2 replication in vitro. Conversely, the overexpression of FHL2 leads to a marked reduction in SARS-CoV-2 replication, with the antiviral property of FHL2 being independent of the cell or virus type. Subsequent experiments reveal that FHL2 supports IFN-beta transcription by upregulating the expression and phosphorylation of IRF-3, thereby impeding SARS-CoV-2 replication in cells. These findings highlight FHL2 as a potential antiviral target for treating SARS-CoV-2 infections.
abstract_zh: SARS-CoV-2引发了全球COVID-19大流行，对全球公共卫生构成严重威胁。SARS-CoV-2感染细胞中的先天免疫反应主要由I型干扰素（IFN）调控，其中IFN-β对SARS-CoV-2复制表现出显著的抑制作用。FHL2作为对接位点，促进多蛋白复合物的组装并调控多种基因的转录。然而，SARS-CoV-2与FHL2之间的关联仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们首次报道SARS-CoV-2感染Caco2细胞导致FHL2表达上调，而病毒的N蛋白可增强FHL2表达。值得注意的是，敲低FHL2显著增强SARS-CoV-2在体外的复制。相反，过表达FHL2则导致SARS-CoV-2复制显著减少，且FHL2的抗病毒特性不依赖于细胞或病毒类型。后续实验揭示，FHL2通过上调IRF-3的表达和磷酸化来支持IFN-β转录，从而抑制SARS-CoV-2在细胞中的复制。这些发现凸显了FHL2作为治疗SARS-CoV-2感染的潜在抗病毒靶点。
